premise: Seal wants to surf like Nico; she slides straight off the spinning rubber ring, until Nico tells her she doesn't need a board, and she rides the wave herself.
inspiration: The 'borrowed feathers' fable (Aesop's jackdaw) turned kind: she doesn't need someone else's thing, she was made for it already.
lesson: You may already have what you need.

en-US.title: The Seal Who Wanted to Surf
en-US.text: {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico grabbed his board and {surfer:go to sea by surf} paddled out. Whoosh! Up he stood, riding a wave. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Seal watched from the rocks. {seal:face happy} {seal:live} She clapped her flippers. Arf! She wanted to surf too! {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} The rubber ring came bobbing by. {seal:go to ring by swim} Seal swam over to try riding it. {ring:live} The ring spun round, and round, and round… {seal:spin} and SPLOSH! {sfx:splosh} Off slid Seal. [short pause] Nico called from his board. {surfer:says} [laughs] "Seal! You don't need a board. You can surf all by yourself!" {seal:wobble} So Seal tried. She stretched out long and smooth, and when the next wave came… {seal:glow 0.4} she rode it, whoosh, like a grey, whiskery surfboard! [laughs] {surfer:go to sand by surf} {seal:go to shore by swim} Side by side, they rode the wave all the way in. {surfer:live} Nico waved his board in the air. {seal:face happy} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] "Again?" {seal:hearts} Arf, arf!

es-ES.title: La foca que quería hacer surf
es-ES.text: {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico cogió su tabla y {surfer:go to sea by surf} remó mar adentro. ¡Fiuuu! Se puso de pie sobre una ola. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Foca lo miraba desde las rocas. {seal:face happy} {seal:live} Dio palmadas con las aletas. ¡Arf! ¡Ella también quería hacer surf! {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} El flotador pasó meciéndose. {seal:go to ring by swim} Foca nadó hasta él para probar a subirse. {ring:live} El flotador dio vueltas, y vueltas, y vueltas… {seal:spin} y ¡CHOF! {sfx:splosh} Foca resbaló al agua. [short pause] Nico la llamó desde su tabla. {surfer:says} [laughs] «¡Foca! No te hace falta tabla. ¡Tú puedes surfear sola!» {seal:wobble} Así que Foca lo intentó. Se estiró, larga y suave, y cuando llegó la siguiente ola… {seal:glow 0.4} ¡la cabalgó, fiuuu, como una tabla de surf gris y con bigotes! [laughs] {surfer:go to sand by surf} {seal:go to shore by swim} Juntos, cabalgaron la ola hasta la orilla. {surfer:live} Nico agitó su tabla en el aire. {seal:face happy} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] «¿Otra vez?» {seal:hearts} ¡Arf, arf!
